purpose: Express the great degree of a feeling or experience.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
Question word + plain clause + ことか
How eagerly I waited for the day I could return!
How many times I have climbed this hill!
What a relief it was to hear they were safe!
formation: Question word + plain clause + ことか
restrictions: Typically combines with どれほど, 何度, or どんなに.
mistake: This is an exclamation, not an ordinary request for an answer.
